`final class VulkanPipelineCache`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render.pipeline` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanPipelineCache.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/pipeline/VulkanPipelineCache.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

The graphics pipelines of the Vulkan renderer, one per pipeline key and kind of target.

## Description

The viewport, the scissor, the cull mode, the front face, the depth test and write and the stencil are dynamic states, so they create no pipeline.
